scope: Public bibliography only; 18 originally requested arXiv records, two strong-coupling baryon journal comparators, two Page hybrid-baryon proceedings records, and two classic quark-model references.

fieldPolicy.primaryURL: Canonical arXiv abstract URL where identified, otherwise the primary publisher article URL; additional publisher and author-copy sources are identified separately.
fieldPolicy.titleAndAuthors: Exact arXiv metadata unless an explicitly retrieved publisher record is used for the published citation; source variants are retained without conflation.
fieldPolicy.year: Publication year when explicitly supplied; otherwise arXiv first-submission year. Citation keys follow that year.
fieldPolicy.doi: Related publication DOI only when explicitly retrieved; null means not provided by the consulted primary record, not proven nonexistent.
fieldPolicy.journal: Transcribed journal-reference fields or retrieved publisher fields; null means unavailable. Pages also hold published article identifiers for compatibility with BibTeX styles.
fieldPolicy.topicClassification: Bibliographic grouping only, not a claim that a paper supports a scientific result.
fieldPolicy.modelBoundary: Canonical Hamiltonian/Peter-Weyl formulations and quantum link models are retained as separate literature, not identified as the same model.
fieldPolicy.contentBoundary: No full-text scientific-support assessment is asserted; only public bibliographic metadata are recorded.
